name: io.github.wong-angel-bls/gsa_mcp_hackathon
description: BLS Public Data Server — an MCP server for the GSA MCP Hackathon that provides accurate, structured access to Bureau of Labor Statistics time-series data. Supports natural-language question answering, series ID discovery, construction, decoding, and validation across SM, CE, LA, JT, and CU surveys via the BLS Public Data API (v1/v2).
